test_ScalarQuantizer_encode_decode: test ScalarQuantizer encode and decode with QT_4bit, QT_fp16, QT_8bit_uniform, and QT_4bit_uniform quantization types
test_ScalarQuantizer_tqmse_encode_decode: test ScalarQuantizer encode and decode with TQMSE quantization types QT_1bit_tqmse through QT_8bit_tqmse on normalized vectors
test_ScalarQuantizer_search_recall: test ScalarQuantizer search recall using index_factory with SQ4 and SQfp16 against a flat L2 ground truth index
test_ScalarQuantizer_distance_reconstruc: test that ScalarQuantizer search distances match manually computed L2 distances from reconstructed vectors
test_ScalarQuantizer_edge_cases: test ScalarQuantizer with zero vectors, constant vectors, extreme dimensions, and non-SIMD-aligned dimensions
